title: Zelt pricing - Free Starter tier for up to 5 users, Core plan from £5/user/month
clean_text: Zelt offers a free Starter tier for up to 5 users, and a Core plan starting at £5 (about $5 USD equivalent) per user per month. Pricing for larger, midmarket deployments (1,000+ employees) is not publicly detailed and would require a custom quote.

meta.pricing_model: tiered subscription, per-user, free starter tier
